lessonRules.text: Stay inside the unit: use only the words, sentences and patterns this unit of the book teaches (words from earlier units are fine for review). Never invent new words or sentences that are not in the book.
Show the book's own pictures for the unit words, so the child sees the same pictures as in class. Use an emoji only when the book has no picture for a word.
Reading uses the book's own reading texts and sentences, word for word (dialogues, chants, short texts) — not new stories.
Keep everything clear and easy for a young child: one idea at a time, very short instructions, familiar pictures, a few choices, cheerful feedback.
